data.name: Bhanuprasad
data.gender_notes: Bhanuprasad is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Bhanuprasad is a combination of two words - Bhanu and Prasad. Bhanu is a name of the Sun God, while Prasad means blessing. Therefore, Bhanuprasad means 'the blessing of Lord Bhanu'. This name is often given to a child born on a Sunday, as the Sun is the ruling planet of this day. The name Bhanuprasad carries the meaning “Blessing of Lord Bhanu” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Bhanuprasad usually hope their child will grow to embody blessing of lord bhanu and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that symbolizes the blessings and protection of the Sun God.
data.etymology: Bhanuprasad belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Blessing of Lord Bhanu.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bhanuprasad total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
